lifepath.title: Your LifePath
lifepath.body: Live a character’s money life, month by month, from opening a bank account to investing.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.body: Quick games on everyday money, staying safe and investing.

quickplay.title: Quick Play
quickplay.body: One situation, two choices. See what happens.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.body: What you’ve learned and badges you’ve earned.

help.title: Lost money to a scam?
help.body: Call 1930 (cybercrime helpline) and tell your bank right away.

continue.title: Continue learning
continue.empty: Begin at Stage 0 and work up.

daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.body: One question a day keeps your streak going. Missing a day never removes progress.

badges.title: Badges
badges.body: Earned for understanding and good habits, never for money.

hub.noSave: You have not played a month yet. This starts at your birthday, in the prologue.

learn.title: Lessons
learn.body: Interest, inflation, shares and funds, one short room at a time. Nothing here uses real companies.

safe.title: Stay Safe
safe.body: A simulated phone full of scams. Spot the tells before they cost you anything real.

simulations.title: Simulations
simulations.subtitle: Try real situations with made-up money. Nothing here costs you anything.

minigames.title: Mini games
minigames.subtitle: Quick games on each topic. Pick one and play.
